entities.summary: Vladimir Vasilievich Nazarov is a Russian composer, singer, actor, film director, artistic director of the Music Theatre of National Arts, Professor Gnessin State Musical College and R. Glier Kyiv Institute of Music. Honored Artist of the RSFSR (1987). People's Artist of Russia (2004).
